dossier.body:
# About you

You run four days a week to stay fit and keep your head clear: Tuesday and Thursday before work, Saturday, and a slightly longer run on Sunday. About 30 to 35 km a week, all easy, and no races planned. You have run like this for three years without injury and want to keep it that way. Tuesday and Thursday are capped at about 50 minutes by work.
